The exam is your chance to **show that you have mastered and understood the material**.


\vspace{2em}

\begin{alertblock}{Academic fraud}
Even \emph{having} these on you in the exam room will be considered as
academic fraud. When in doubt, leave it at the front of the room.
\end{alertblock}

## Grade calculation

Your final grade is out of 20:

```{=latex}
\vspace{1em}
\begin{center}
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=5.2mm]
  \fill[ibmA]  (0,0)  rectangle (16,0.8);
  \fill[ibmB]  (16,0) rectangle (19,0.8);
  \fill[ibmE]  (19,0) rectangle (20,0.8);
  \foreach \x in {16,19} \draw[white, thick] (\x,0) -- (\x,0.8);
  \node[white, font=\bfseries] at (8,0.4) {Exam: 16};
  \node[white, font=\bfseries\small] at (17.5,0.4) {3};
  \node[font=\bfseries\small] at (19.5,0.4) {1};
  \draw[ibmB, thick] (16,-0.1) -- (16,-0.4) -- (19,-0.4) -- (19,-0.1);
  \node[ibmB, font=\scriptsize, below] at (17.5,-0.4) {Quizzes};
  \draw[ibmE!80!black, thick] (19.5,0.9) -- (19.5,1.3);
  \node[ibmE!80!black, font=\scriptsize, above left] at (20,1.3) {Practical attendance};
  \foreach \x in {0,5,10,15,20}
    \node[gray, font=\tiny, below] at (\x,-0.8) {\x};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{center}
```

## How to write your answers

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="48%"}
\begin{block}{Scratch paper}
\begin{itemize}
\item Do calculations
\item Try out ideas
\item Make mistakes!
\end{itemize}
Not graded.
\end{block}
:::
::: {.column width="48%"}
\begin{exampleblock}{Answer sheet}
\begin{itemize}
\item Your final, clean argument
\item Every step justified
\item Final answer clearly marked
\end{itemize}
This is what we grade.
\end{exampleblock}
:::
::::

\vspace{1em}

Be very mindful:

- **Show your work!** A correct answer without justification earns few points;
  a clear argument with a small slip earns many.
- **Leave enough time to finish writing!** Keep the last 15 minutes for copying
  out and checking.

## Layout of your answer sheet

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
- Do not write across the margins
- Don't write solutions next to each other on the same page
- Write clearly and cleanly
- Number your answers so that they match the questions
:::
::: {.column width="45%"}
```{=latex}
\begin{center}
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=0.8]
  % page
  \draw[fill=white, rounded corners=1pt] (0,0) rectangle (3.5,4.6);
  \draw[ibmC, dashed] (0.4,0) -- (0.4,4.6);
  \draw[ibmC, dashed] (3.1,0) -- (3.1,4.6);
  % question 1
  \node[font=\tiny\bfseries, anchor=west] at (0.5,4.3) {Q1};
  \foreach \y in {4.0,3.75,3.5,3.25,3.0}
    \draw[ibmA, line width=1.5pt] (0.6,\y) -- ({0.6+2.2*(1-0.15*mod(\y*4,3))},\y);
  % question 2
  \node[font=\tiny\bfseries, anchor=west] at (0.5,2.5) {Q2};
  \foreach \y in {2.2,1.95,1.7,1.45,1.2,0.95}
    \draw[ibmB, line width=1.5pt] (0.6,\y) -- ({0.6+2.2*(1-0.15*mod(\y*4,3))},\y);
  \node[ibmC, font=\tiny, below] at (1.75,0) {stay inside the margins};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{center}
```
:::
::::

## What to study

- Re-do problems from theory and practicals
- Do some extra problems
- Use sample exams wisely
  - Time yourself
  - Focus on hard problems

\vspace{1em}

\begin{block}{A good test}
Pick a random exercise from any chapter. Can you solve it \emph{without} looking
at your notes or the solution? If not, that chapter needs more practice.
\end{block}

## Asking for help

```{=latex}
\vspace{1em}
\begin{center}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
    box/.style={rounded corners=4pt, minimum width=45mm, minimum height=14mm,
                align=center, text=black}]
  \node[box, fill=ibmA!20] (you) at (0,0) {\textbf{You}\\\scriptsize stuck on a problem};
  \node[box, fill=ibmB!20] (ta) at (6,0) {\textbf{TAs or myself}\\\scriptsize happy to help};
  \draw[-{Stealth[length=3mm]}, thick, gray] (you) -- (ta);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{center}
```

\vspace{1.5em}

- **Show your work.** Tell us where you got stuck, not just which problem.
- **Early is better than late.** The day before the exam is too late to
  untangle a whole chapter.

## On the day of the exam

```{=latex}
\vspace{0.5em}
\begin{center}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
    dot/.style={circle, minimum size=4mm, inner sep=0pt},
    lbl/.style={align=center, font=\scriptsize, text width=22mm}]
  \draw[thick, gray!50] (0,0) -- (9.6,0);
  \foreach \x/\c/\t/\pos in {
      0/ibmA/{Go to the\\correct room}/above,
      2.4/ibmA/{Wait outside\\until called in}/below,
      4.8/ibmB/{Leave bags \& coats\\at the front,\\phone \emph{off}}/above,
      7.2/ibmB/{Sit at the desk\\with your name}/below,
      9.6/ibmD/{\textbf{8:30}\\Exam starts}/above} {
    \node[dot, fill=\c] at (\x,0) {};
    \node[lbl, \pos=3mm] at (\x,0) {\t};
  }
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{center}
```

\vspace{1.5em}

At the end (when you are done):

- Hand in **all** your papers: answer sheets *and* scratch paper
- Leave the room quietly; others are still working
